rules.title: Documented lawful basis for personal data
rules.statement: Personal data must only be collected or processed when a lawful basis is documented in the data inventory before processing starts.
rules.rationale: GDPR Art. 6 and our Data Privacy Standard section 2.

rules.title: EU personal data stays in the EU unless a transfer mechanism is approved
rules.statement: Personal data of EU residents must not be stored or processed outside the EU/EEA unless Legal has approved a transfer mechanism such as Standard Contractual Clauses.

rules.title: Verifiable parental consent for children under 13
rules.statement: Products or features directed at children under 13 must obtain verifiable parental consent before collecting any personal information from the child, including email addresses.

rules.title: Retention limit of 24 months
rules.statement: Personal data should not be retained for more than 24 months after the last customer interaction.
rules.exception_process: The Data Protection Officer may approve a longer retention period with a documented justification.

rules.title: Marketing email requires opt-in and unsubscribe
rules.statement: Marketing emails must only be sent to recipients who have opted in, and every marketing email must contain a working unsubscribe link.

rules.title: Comparative claims need documented testing
rules.statement: Advertising that compares our product with a named competitor must be substantiated by documented, reproducible testing kept on file.
rules.rationale: Misleading-advertising law; Marketing Claims Guidelines section 3.
rules.exception_process: Legal may approve a comparative claim based on published third-party data.

rules.title: Superlative claims need third-party evidence
rules.statement: Claims such as "best", "#1" or "fastest" should be backed by independent third-party evidence cited in the material.
rules.exception_process: The VP of Marketing may approve clearly subjective puffery.

rules.title: Security review before general availability
rules.statement: Every new product or major feature must complete a security review and have all critical findings resolved before general availability.

rules.title: Localised terms and privacy notice in new markets
rules.statement: Launching in a new country requires terms of service and a privacy notice in the official local language.
rules.rationale: Consumer protection law in most markets.
rules.exception_process: Regional counsel may approve an English-only launch for up to 90 days.

rules.title: Encrypt customer data at rest and in transit
rules.statement: Customer data must be encrypted at rest and in transit using approved algorithms (AES-256 at rest, TLS 1.2+ in transit).

rules.title: Vendor risk assessment for data processors
rules.statement: Third-party vendors that process customer data should have a completed vendor risk assessment from the last 12 months before data is shared.
rules.exception_process: The CISO may grant a 60-day exception while the assessment is completed.

rules.title: Disclose AI-generated interactions
rules.statement: Customer-facing features that use AI to generate content or responses should clearly disclose to users that AI is involved.
rules.exception_process: Product counsel may approve omitting the disclosure for internal-only tools.

rules.title: No customer data for third-party model training without consent
rules.statement: Customer data must not be used to train or fine-tune third-party AI models without explicit, recorded customer consent.

rules.title: CFO approval for discounts above 40 percent
rules.statement: Discounts or promotions above 40 percent off list price must be approved in writing by the CFO before they are announced.
